SHALL APPLY TO ALL OPERATORS AND AIRCRAFT ARRIVING IN MAURITIUS:

THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS, EXCEPT AS PROVIDED IN PARAGRAPHS
2 AND 3 BELOW.

TRANSITED THROUGH THE DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO, UGANDA OR SOUTH
SUDAN DURING THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS SHALL BE PERMITTED TO
BOARD FLIGHTS TO MAURITIUS. UPON ARRIVAL, SUCH PASSENGERS SHALL BE
SUBJECT TO QUARANTINE, MEDICAL ASSESSMENT AND MONITORING BY THE
MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND WELLNESS.
3. NON-CITIZENS WHO HAVE DEPARTED FROM, TRAVELLED TO, OR TRANSITED
THROUGH THE DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO, UGANDA OR SOUTH SUDAN
DURING THE PRECEDING TWENTY-ONE (21) DAYS SHALL BE PERMITTED TO BOARD
FLIGHTS TO MAURITIUS ONLY IF THEY HOLD VALID DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE OF:
A.A RESIDENCE PERMIT
B.AN OCCUPATION PERMIT
C.A WORK PERMIT
D.A STUDENT PERMIT
E.A PERMIT AS SPOUSE OF A MAURITIAN CITIZEN OR 
F. A PREMIUM VISA.

MEDICAL ASSESSMENT AND MONITORING BY THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND
WELLNESS.

COMPLETE AND PRESENT THE PRESCRIBED ALL-IN-ONE HEALTH DECLARATION
FORM PRIOR TO BOARDING.

AUTHORITIES OF ANY SUSPECTED CASE OF EBOLA VIRUS DISEASE ON BOARD AND
SHALL COMPLY WITH ALL PUBLIC HEALTH DIRECTIONS ISSUED BY THE MINISTRY
OF HEALTH AND WELLNESS.
6.AIRCRAFT OPERATORS SHALL ENSURE STRICT COMPLIANCE WITH THE ABOVE
REQUIREMENTS. PASSENGERS WHO DO NOT MEET THE CONDITIONS SPECIFIED
HEREIN SHALL NOT BE ACCEPTED FOR CARRIAGE TO MAURITIUS.
7.ISOLATION AND PUBLIC HEALTH RESPONSE PROCEDURES FOR SUSPECTED CASES
SHALL BE IMPLEMENTED IN COORDINATION WITH THE MINISTRY OF HEALTH AND
WELLNESS.
8.THIS NOTAM REMAINS IN FORCE UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE.
